card.name: Words introducing a numeric range
card.fires_on: The word just before the first number of a range, mainly "between" or "from" after "ranges", "receiving" or "weighing". Also the space or decimal point right before the first number of a range.

modes.label: Range-opening word
modes.description: "between" or "from" that introduces a span of numbers, such as doses, weights or clearance values.
modes.example: For patients weighing<< between>> 1.5 kg and less than

modes.label: Just before range number
modes.description: A space or decimal point right before the first number in a stated range.
modes.example: The therapeutic range is<< >>4 to 20 mg a day

card.plain: It lights up right where a range of numbers is about to start, such as "between 1 and 10" or "from 45 to 79".
